conflicts: 6s 3S°1 lifetime: laser 3.1(5) ns (Bengtsson et al. 1992) vs beam-foil 2.4(4) ns (Dynefors 1975) vs 2.2(2) ns derived from relative transition probabilities; laser value kept. The NIST ASD A values of the 214.3 / 238.3 / 238.6 nm lines (3.12e8, 4.04e7, 8.08e7 s^-1, Ubelis and Berzinsh scale) sum to 4.3e8 s^-1, i.e. tau x sum(A) = 1.34 with the 3.1 ns laser lifetime; the Roederer et al. 2012 values stored here (2.31e8, 3.0e7, 6.0e7, 9.0e5 s^-1) are renormalised to 3.1 ns and give 1.00.

7p level called '5P2' by Zerne et al. 1994 (99(8) ns): excitation / detection wavelengths 588 / 515 nm fit the NIST level 63669.944 cm^-1, which NIST labels 'b 5P1' (J = 1), not the NIST 5P2 level 63610.819 cm^-1 (589.53 / 516.44 nm in air, against 587.48 / 514.87 nm for 63669.944). The lifetime is stored on 63669.944; the J label of that level differs between Zerne et al. and NIST.
notes: Thin file: neutral Te has little modern precision spectroscopy in open sources. The three lifetimes come from an abstract (OSTI/ETDEWEB record of Z. Phys. D 32, 31), read through an automated page reader and not checked against the printed paper. NIST carries A values for six 5p4 - 5p3 6s lines (Ubelis & Berzinsh); nothing better was found. Abundances: NIST isotopic compositions (120Te 0.09(1) %, 130Te 34.08(62) %). Third pass (2026-10-02): added the 6s 3S1 and 6s 5S2 lifetimes, the a 5P1 lifetime (identified through the excitation wavelengths printed on p. 32 of Zerne et al.), 123,125Te hyperfine constants and the 214 nm isotope shifts of 120-136Te from the open PhD thesis of R. Sifi (HAL tel-00252001, saved as pdf/Te_Sifi_2007.pdf). In that thesis A is the ground-level constant and A' the 6s 3S1 constant; isotope shifts are nu(A) - nu(130). Extra fields beyond SCHEMA.md: oscillator_strength_abs, isotope_shift_note, lifetime_alternatives. Fourth pass (2026-10-02): the four 7p lifetimes of Zerne et al. 1994 (128(11), 99(8), 82(10), 124(8) ns) were read a second time, independently, in the abstract on the Lund University publication record (https://lup.lub.lu.se/record/2259787) and agree with the stored values; the printed pages 33-34 are still unread.
